title: Don't buy for anything but one time use.
text: Don't buy for anything but one time use.. Lost several branches while setting it up. The tree will not stand up straight, and tips super easy so don't use in a small space. When taking the tree down, lost more branches. Probably only good for one time use. Pretty but poorly made!
